spec.text: Image 1 is a frame from a scene; image 2 is the woman's FACE reference sheet and image 3 the man's FACE reference sheet - copy their faces exactly (large round dark-brown eyes with white catchlights, small button noses, round blushing cheeks; he wears thick black rectangular glasses); images 4 and 5 are their full-body model sheets; image 6 is the art style. Draw the SAME moment as image 1 from the OPPOSITE side: the camera has orbited 180 degrees around the couple. Now the man stands with his back and black backpack toward the camera on the left, and over his shoulder we see the woman facing the camera, one hand covering her mouth, smiling, eyes open and bright. Behind her is the night plaza of the park with trees, garden lights and a stone bench; a soft teal glow from the library's glass facade (now behind the camera) lights her face. Same night lighting, same outfits, same clay storybook style. Medium shot, her face large and clearly visible. No readable text, no other people, no photorealism.
